value.rationale: The Calyx is a standard nonnormal test surface for resolution. In a genuinely wild characteristic its normalization changes from a singular rational-double-point surface to a smooth plane, while its divisorial normalization defect acquires a distinct component carrying an inseparable residual map. Exact conductor and quotient modules make this substantive geometric boundary usable in degeneration and singularity calculations, not a parameter renaming or only a numerical exercise.
